title: Philips TPM191E (TP Vision, device PH9M_EA_5599, MediaTek mt5887), Europe
header:
Philips TPM191E (TP Vision, device PH9M_EA_5599, MediaTek mt5887), Europe
Android TV 12 (API 31), firmware STT2.230526.001, security patch 2025-11-01.
Fingerprint: Philips/PH9M_EA_5599/PH9M_EA_5599:12/STT2.230526.001/4215:user/release-keys
About 2 GB RAM, armeabi-v7a. Vendor packages use the org.droidtv prefix.

Not the same board as examples/philips-50pus8517 (PH1M_EA_9970A, Android 11) or
examples/philips-55pus7503 (TPM171E, Android 8); entries shared with those lists were checked
against this TV's own `pm list packages`.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/philips-tpm191e/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/philips-tpm191e/debloat.txt com.google.android.tvlauncher
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher
The uk.co.freeview.* packages and org.droidtv.freeviewplayers are disabled from the factory on
this unit, so they are not listed (restore.sh would turn them ON).

Kept on purpose: org.droidtv.amazonalexa (Alexa power on/off), com.google.android.apps.mediashell
(Chromecast), org.droidtv.oad and com.easy.oad (firmware updates), org.droidtv.eum (see the
philips-50pus8517 list: xtv retries forever without it and the sources drawer dies).

sections.note: after launcher/build-and-install.sh has moved Home and disabled com.google.android.tvlauncher. The stock launcher holds a stable provider reference into this package, so disabling it first would kill the live launcher. It is also the only handler for the notification side panel (OPEN_NOTIFICATIONS_PANEL, TOGGLE_NOTIFICATION_HANDLER_PANEL) on this firmware: that panel goes too.
